name: Banana Bunch
card_quote: "I like CT but I can't commit to playing every day. I want something more laid back."
card_desc: → Banana Bunch has you covered. A relaxed CT team aimed at a more nurturing experience for learning. Use at least some of your attacks every day and learn at your own pace.
modal_quote: "I like CT but I can't commit to playing every day. I want something more laid back."
modal_desc: Banana Bunch is a laid-back CT team focused on giving players a nurturing, low-pressure environment to learn and enjoy the event. Perfect for players who want to participate in CT without the weight of strict requirements. Use at least some of your attacks each day, pick up tips from the people around you, and enjoy the event at your own pace.
requirements: Use at least some attacks daily — just contribute what you can
Willingness to learn — Bunch is a learning environment, lean into it
Respectful attitude — be kind, be patient, and remember everyone's at a different stage
No minimum score requirements — just participate and engage with the event
